ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-09-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Dave Davenport, Bailiff: L. Perotti.
Petitioner: Roel Jamin Bolio Estrella, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Olivia Bloo Estrella Burnette, was sworn and examined.
Order Dispensing with Notice is in file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Olivia Bloo Bolio Burnette.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-12-2005 Reset To Jun-09-05 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
